productLossClosed: The Lynx provider-family rail no longer lets icon events pass through the rail item that owns the provider-selection tap.
A real pointer or Native touch changes the active provider family, replaces the model rows, and keeps the picker open so a model can be chosen.
harnessMismatch: The previous Browser provider-rail certification used Element.click() for Lynx after Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent failed. That bypassed hit testing and incorrectly certified the real pointer path.

The corrected shared-workbench harness removes the Lynx DOM-click fallback, uses real Web and Lynx CDP pointers, records hit-test diagnostics and a causal provider timeline, and waits for the same stable notification precondition before opening either picker.

The live dual-renderer fixture currently has an unrelated late provider-update notification race that can close both overlays before the rail pointer is sent. This is retained as harness loss, not product evidence.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Shipping Browser Preview proves the Lynx-for-Web hit-testing path with a real Chromium pointer against the built Lynx bundle. Exact Native proves the production bundle with measured DevTool touch, main transport, isolated state, and zero renderer errors. Neither probe changes a model; provider-family browsing intentionally keeps the picker open.

browserPreview.input: CDP mouseMoved + mousePressed + mouseReleased at the measured Claude rail item
browserPreview.hitTargetClass: model-picker-rail-item relative flex aspect-square w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md

native.input: DevTool Input.emulateTouchFromMouseEvent on the measured provider rail item
